description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It handles database operations related to timesheets, such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying timesheet and timesheet item data, as well as generating reports and managing related logs. The class uses Doctrine ORM for database interactions and provides methods for filtering and pagination.

classes.name: TimesheetDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for CRUD operations, queries, and report generation related to Timesheet and TimesheetItem entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieves a Timesheet entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheet
methods.description: Persists a Timesheet entity to the database.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByTimesheetIdAndTimesheetItemId
methods.description: Retrieves a TimesheetItem by timesheet ID and timesheet item ID.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsByTimesheetId
methods.description: Returns all TimesheetItems associated with a given timesheet ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheetItem
methods.description: Saves a TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: saveTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Saves a TimesheetActionLog entity.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForStartDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for an employee on a specific start date.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Retrieves action logs for a specific timesheet with filtering options.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of action logs for a timesheet based on filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetByStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Returns timesheets within a specified date range for an employee.

methods.name: getTimesheetCount
methods.description: Counts the number of timesheets matching specific filters.

methods.name: deleteTimesheetRows
methods.description: Deletes specific rows (project, activity combinations) from a timesheet.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItems
methods.description: Handles bulk saving and updating of multiple TimesheetItems.

methods.name: isDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet item with specific project and activity IDs already exists.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of timesheets for an employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for employee timesheet list with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Counts employee timesheets based on filters.

methods.name: getDefaultTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves the default timesheet for an employee, based on date filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Retrieves timesheet items for employee report with filtering.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Counts timesheet items for employee report filters.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration of timesheet items for employee report filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByProjectIdAndTimesheetIdAndActivityIdAndDate
methods.description: Retrieve a specific TimesheetItem by project, timesheet, activity, and date.
